findings.location: Paragraph mentioning Muensterites (source.html paragraph: "Events such as the Muensterites and their violent interpretations of Scripture remained a clear warning...")
findings.source_quote: Events such as the Muensterites and their violent interpretations of Scripture remained a clear warning of religious zeal gone awry.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the proper historical term faithfully. Replace the incorrect "меннонитов в Мюнстере" with a translation that preserves the source reference to the radical Anabaptist group associated with Münster (commonly rendered in Russian as «мюнстериты» or «события в Мюнстере»). For example: «События вроде мюнстеритов и их насильственных толкований Писания оставались наглядным предупреждением…».
findings.translation_quote: «События вроде меннонитов в Мюнстере и их насильственных толкований Писания оставались наглядным предупреждением о религиозном рвении, вышедшем из‑под контроля.»

findings.location: First mention of George Blaurock (source.html: list of founders: "Conrad Grebel, Felix Manz, and George Blaurock")
findings.source_quote: Conrad Grebel, Felix Manz, and George Blaurock
findings.suggested_fix: Use an established Russian rendering of the proper name. The translation shows «Георге Блауроке», which is an unusual inflection/orthography in Russian. Prefer a conventional form such as «Георг Блауэрок» or «Георг Блауэрок (George Blaurock)» depending on house style. Preserve the order and identity of the three founders exactly as in the source.
findings.translation_quote: «Конраде Гребеле, Феликсе Манце и Георге Блауроке»
